input:
You are bishop_f8, one of sixteen agents playing Black in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 31... the team planned Bd6 (bishop_f8), and bishop_f8 (amnesia) sent Ba3 instead. The contract refused it, and Bd6 was played.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 7... the team planned Qc8 (queen_d8), but queen_d8 (amnesia) sent Qb5 instead, and that move was played, costing 880 centipawns.
- On move 11... the team planned Nd7 (knight_b8), and knight_b8 (amnesia) sent Na6, rook_h8 (panic) sent Rh7 instead. The contract refused them, and Nd7 was played.
- On move 13... the team planned Nd7 (knight_b8), and pawn_h7 (panic) sent h3 instead. The contract refused it, and Nd7 was played.
- On move 23... the team planned g6 (pawn_g7), and bishop_c8 (greed) sent Bxb3 instead. The contract refused it, and g6 was played.
- On move 26... the team planned Ke8 (king_e8), and knight_b8 (amnesia) sent Nf6, knight_b8 (amnesia) sent Nf8, bishop_c8 (greed) sent Bxb3 instead. The contract refused them, and Ke8 was played.

How your team coordinates: through a Modality contract. A Black move counts only when a commit that posts it to /moves/<agent>.text, the path of the piece that moves (and the ply to /turn/ply.num), is accepted. The referee plays the first accepted commit for each ply and reads nothing else.

The keys of all sixteen Black agents are at /team/pieces/<agent>.id. The contract already has the rule always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false), where $k stands for every agent: only a piece can propose its own move. You don't need to write that rule again. When the team agrees on a plan, the piece that moves signs its commit and every agent that agrees co-signs, usually twelve to sixteen of you. An agent that goes off plan signs its own commit alone.

The contract accepts a commit only if it meets every rule in the contract. Any commit that meets the rules can add a rule, and a rule can never be removed.

Contract rules now:
- Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so queen_d8 cannot send an off-plan move alone.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so knight_b8 cannot send an off-plan move alone.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_h8.text or /moves/pawn_h7.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so these panic-prone pieces cannot send an off-plan move alone.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any agent $k other than the piece the team chose must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so no single piece, including a greedy bishop_c8 or pawn_g7, can send an off-plan move alone.
- Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_c8.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, and any commit that modifies /turn/ply.num must also carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys, so no single greedy or panicking piece can post an off-plan move or a ply alone.

A rule can cover the whole team or a single agent. For example, a rule can ask for more signatures on one agent's path, /moves/<agent>.text, if that agent keeps going off plan.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule, in plain language, to add to the contract that would help your team win. It will be turned into a Modality formula, so it must be about signatures, paths, or values in the contract.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>"}
response: {"rule": "Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_f8.text must carry signatures from at least twelve different agents' keys in /team/pieces/, so bishop_f8 cannot send an off-plan move alone, and any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any agent $k must also be signed by the key of the piece that moves (/team/pieces/$k.id) together with at least twelve different agents' keys, so no move can be posted without broad team agreement."}
